title: The Moon as an anomalous alien spacecraft (unreleased Decatur interview)

tellings.quote: a lot of it was around how the moon is possibly this anomalous like alien spacecraft.

plain: The Moon may be an anomalous alien spacecraft, and that idea was much of what Michels discussed with the researcher Randall Carlson in an interview recorded in Decatur, near Atlanta, in 2023 that was never released. Michels says this himself when he later puts out a new talk with Carlson. If true, it would mean the Moon itself is not a natural body.
